confirmatory_metadata.name: NoyyalSense-Attribution-Confirmatory
confirmatory_metadata.description: Pragmatic pre-registered confirmatory benchmark evaluating source attribution and uncertainty-aware selective classification under clean baseline and sensor fault conditions.
confirmatory_metadata.disclaimer: Controlled synthetic screening benchmark only. Numerical simulations generated by the 1D ADE engine; not historical measured records from the Noyyal River.
confirmatory_metadata.resampling_protocol: Atomic physical episode cluster bootstrap (B=1000) preserving cross-condition and cross-model pairing.

clean.description: Baseline telemetry without added hardware faults.
